attributes.board_name: New Mexico Board of Pharmacy (Regulation and Licensing Department)

rules.alternatives: No Board CE hours, but an active PTCB or ExCPT certification is required to keep the registration active; those certifiers require their own recertification CE (per the Board FAQ, 20 hours every two years incl. 1 hour pharmacy law).

topics.who: Only technicians who administer vaccines (16.19.22.16 NMAC)

rules.notes: Registration renews every two years on the last day of the birth month; the Board requires no CE hours of its own for technicians (Board FAQ, 2023). Technicians who administer vaccines need 2 hours of vaccine-related CE per registration period.
rules.rule_quote: How many continuing education (CE) hours do I need to renew my registration with the New Mexico Board of Pharmacy? None are required to remain active registration with the New Mexico Board of Pharmacy.
